en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.793 - It was narrated from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Yunus that his father wrote to Imam Abu Al-Hasan (as)
asking about wearing fur or leather socks (khuff) and praying in them without knowing if they were from a properly slaughtered (halal) animal.
He (as) replied: "There is no harm in it”.
